about: Every sealed prereg whose recorded content hash is not simply its original commitment over its whole current file, with how its sealed text can still be checked (or why it cannot), and every sealed prereg removed from this repository. scripts/verify_seals.py checks each entry against git and fails on any change not listed here, on any entry whose facts no longer hold or that is no longer needed, and on any sealed prereg deleted or moved without a 'removed' entry. Each entry locks the file's current content (current_text_sha256) and its post-seal commits, so a later amendment fails the check until it is disclosed here and in claims/REGISTRY-ACCOUNTING.md. Never re-seal a file to remove it from this list: that overwrites the original commitment.
previously_disclosed: Whether the change, or the fact that the recorded hash is not the original commitment, was disclosed anywhere before this audit, and where.

The cause cannot be shown; the likeliest is an edit between running seal.py and committing.
